title: Analyst job (ready-work message) v1
description: Hardware-neutral snapshot of one ready Logical Job, published at least once to the stamp-local analysis job subjects. Possession of this message confers no authority: an Analyst Manager must claim the Logical Job through the platform API (POST /api/v1/analysis/logical-jobs/{logicalJobId}/claims with this message's readinessOccurrenceId and messageId and a Manager-chosen Idempotency-Key) and acknowledges the delivery only after the platform returns a successful claim (201, or 200 for a replay of the same key) or a deterministically obsolete outcome (404, or 409 claim-obsolete). If a claim response is lost, the Manager retries the claim with the same Idempotency-Key and receives the same attempt, lease, and fencing token while that attempt is still current. The payload never selects a Manager, host, container runtime product, accelerator model, or preprocessing strategy, and never carries a stamp or club discriminator, credentials, URLs, broker connection details, or media.

messageId.description: Stable message identity; identical for every republication of this readiness occurrence.

readinessOccurrenceId.description: Identity of the readiness occurrence that this message announces. A claim must name it.

readinessSequence.description: 1 for the first readiness of the Logical Job, incremented for each retry readiness.

logicalJobId.description: Stable Logical Job identity across retries.

recordingSetVersionId.description: Finalized recording-set version that is the source lineage of the run.

schemaVersion.description: Result schema version the Analyst must produce.

segment.description: Present exactly for segment-scoped jobs. Match-scoped jobs carry no synthetic segment.

inputs.description: Input snapshot recorded when the Logical Job first became ready. Every declared dependency appears exactly once.

pinned.description: Run-pinned execution identities, identical for every Logical Job of the capability and for every retry.

modelDigest.description: Null for capabilities without a model artifact.

resources.description: Hardware-neutral minimum resource requirements copied from the resolved Analyst profile.

status.description: accepted: consumed; absent: optional input without an accepted result when the job became ready; failed: optional upstream failed; not-applicable: conditional predicate did not apply.

acceptedResults.description: Accepted upstream results consumed; empty unless status is accepted. A match-scoped job depending on a segment-scoped capability lists every required segment result.
